app.title: Volleyball Scoresheet Assistant
app.tagline: Guides you through an international scoresheet, then walks you box by box so you can copy it onto the paper sheet.
app.footer: Everything stays in this browser. The paper sheet remains the official record; this only helps you fill it in without arithmetic mistakes.
app.needSheet: Start or open a sheet first.

start.label: Match
start.hint: Pick a fixture or start blank

sheet.label: Transfer
sheet.hint: Guided copy onto the paper sheet

start.title: Start a sheet
start.subtitle: Import a fixture to prefill the header, teams and officials, or start from a blank sheet.
start.body: With a federation token the header, both squads and the referees arrive filled in. Without one, the same sheet works, you just type the details yourself.

browser.title: Browse fixtures
browser.unsupported: {{name}} does not offer fixture browsing. Start a blank sheet and type the match details in.
browser.needCredential: {{name}} needs {{credential}} before it can list games. Add it under Settings, or start a blank sheet and fill everything in by hand.
browser.empty: No fixtures came back for this region and date range.
browser.noMatch: No loaded fixture matches these filters.
browser.more: {{count}} more fixtures match. Narrow the filters to reach them.

header.title: Match header
header.subtitle: The top band of the scoresheet.

rules.title: Rules
rules.subtitle: Drives set targets, substitution and time-out limits.
rules.summary: Best of {{best}}, sets to {{points}}, deciding set to {{deciding}}, {{substitutions}} substitutions and {{timeouts}} time-outs per set.

teams.home: Home team on the fixture list.
teams.away: Visiting team on the fixture list.
teams.notImported: This team was not imported from {{name}}, so there is no roster to pull. Type the players in.
teams.noCaptain: No captain marked. The sheet needs the captain circled.

toss.title: Toss
toss.subtitle: Recorded in the header band before set 1.

play.setNotStarted: That set has not been started.

lineups.title: Set {{number}} lineups
lineups.subtitle: Positions I to VI double as the service order.
lineups.decidingHint: The deciding set starts with a new toss.
lineups.locked: The set has started; change the lineup only to fix a transcription error.

scoring.title: Set {{number}} scoring
scoring.setFinished: Set {{number}} finished {{a}}:{{b}} to team {{side}}. Write the duration in the results box.

sanctions.title: Sanctions
sanctions.subtitle: Team, member, set and score go in the sanctions box.

engine.tooManySubstitutions: Team {{side}} has more substitutions than the {{allowed}} the rules allow.
engine.tooManyTimeouts: Team {{side}} has more time-outs than the {{allowed}} the rules allow.
engine.incompleteLineup: Team {{side}} has only {{filled}} of 6 starting positions filled for set {{number}}.
engine.noFirstServe: Set {{number}} has no first service recorded yet.
engine.liberoServing: Team {{side}} has a libero in the service position, which these rules do not allow.

blocker.noSet: This set has not been started.
blocker.noFirstServe: Record which team serves first in this set.
blocker.lineup: Team {{side}} needs all six starting positions before the first rally.

sub.emptySlot: That position has no player on court yet.
sub.samePlayer: That player is already on court in this position.
sub.alreadyOnCourt: That player is already on court.
sub.allUsed: Team {{side}} has already used all {{allowed}} substitutions in this set.
sub.libero: Libero replacements are not substitutions and are not recorded here.
sub.starterNotOut: That starter has not left the court, so there is nothing to re-enter.
sub.starterReturned: A starter may only re-enter once per set.
sub.starterPairing: A starter may only re-enter for the player who replaced them.
sub.substituteReturned: A substitute may only enter once per set.

transfer.title: Transfer to the paper sheet
transfer.subtitle: One box at a time, in the order a scorer fills the sheet in.
transfer.restart: Start again from the first box
transfer.allDone: Every box is marked copied. Check the totals against the paper sheet before signing.
transfer.noPlayers: No players entered for team {{side}} yet.
transfer.noRallies: No rallies recorded in this set yet.

header.title: Header and officials
header.help: Top band of the sheet. Copy competition, match number, date, time and venue, then both team names and the officials. Write the names exactly as they appear on the licences.

toss.title: Toss and sides
toss.help: Mark which team serves and which team is on the left for set 1. Teams change ends every set; the deciding set has its own toss and a change of ends at 8.

roster.title: Team {{side}} roster
roster.help: Fill the team column in shirt-number order, circle the captain and mark each libero with an L. Add the coach and assistant coach underneath.

lineup.title: Set {{number}}: starting lineups
lineup.help: Write each starting six into positions I to VI. That order is also the service order, so it must match what the coach handed in on the lineup slip.

score.title: Set {{number}}: running score
score.help: Work down the service rounds: enter the serving player number, then strike out every point won on that service. The rally list underneath shows the running score after each point.

changes.title: Set {{number}}: substitutions and time-outs
changes.help: Enter each substitution in the position it happened in, with the incoming number above the outgoing one and the score alongside. Time-outs go in the small boxes as the score at which they were taken.

results.title: Results table
results.help: One row per set: duration, both scores, substitutions, time-outs and the winner. Add the set durations from the clock, then total the points and the match duration.

sanctions.title: Sanctions
sanctions.help: One line per sanction with the team, the member, the set and the score at which it was given.

remarks.title: Remarks and signatures
remarks.help: Write any remarks, then collect the signatures: captains first, then the coaches, the scorer and finally both referees.

submit.title: Report the result
submit.help: The paper sheet stays with the referee. The result still has to reach the federation, so copy the summary below into the federation system.

sheet.signatureNote: Signatures go on paper: captains sign after the match, then the coaches and referees.

submit.title: Report the result

noApi.title: No direct submission
noApi.body: {{name}} publishes fixtures, teams and squads but accepts no scoresheet over its API, so the result cannot be filed from here. Copy the summary below into the federation system, and hand the paper sheet to the referee as usual.

submit.manualBody: No federation is selected, so there is nothing to file the result with. The summary below is still the shortest way to report it by whatever route your competition uses.
submit.checklist: Before you hand the sheet over

check.totals: The points total per set matches the running score.
check.signatures: Both captains, both coaches and both referees have signed.
check.durations: Every set duration and the match duration are written in.
check.sanctions: Every sanction is in the sanctions box with its score.

settings.title: Federation
settings.subtitle: Which country's data source fills the sheet in for you.
settings.privacy: The token is kept in this browser's local storage and sent only to the federation's API over HTTPS. Nothing is uploaded anywhere else, and the app has no backend. Without a token everything still works, you just type the match details in yourself.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Applies to the whole app and is remembered in this browser.
language.label: Language

swiss.tokenHelp: A club administrator generates one in Volley Manager under Administration > Club > Webservice/API. It is sent as the Authorization header and is stored only in this browser.

federation.noToken: No {{name}} token configured. Add one in Settings, or keep using manual entry.
